Hi Samantha —

Thanks for sending the MSA and order form back with redlines. Before we finalize the documents I want to lock down the publicity pieces so legal has a single set of asks to accept/decline:

Quick summary of what we need from you:
- Confirmation you’re comfortable with the publicity clause in the attached MSA redlines (Meridian_MSA_redlines_v1.docx).
- Permission to use a short customer quote (1–2 sentences) and Meridian logo in marketing materials / case study.
- Any specific embargo window or channels you want to restrict (e.g., internal comms only, press release embargo).

Ask: Can you confirm the above and share any internal review contacts (legal/comms) who should sign off? If you prefer, Laura (cc’d) can propose alternative language that narrows the clause to timeline/approval steps.

Attachment: Meridian_MSA_redlines_v1.docx

Thanks — we’re excited to get this live and want to ensure the publicity language aligns with your process.

Hi team —

I reviewed the redlines Ben forwarded. High level comments and suggested language below to keep publicity rights narrow and reviewable:

Proposed changes (summary):
1) Quote approval: Insert explicit 5-business-day review window for Meridian to approve any proposed customer quote. If no response in that window, the quote will not be used.
2) Logo usage: Limit to marketing and sales collateral; require use of Meridian Brand Guidelines (attachable). No use in paid ads without separate approval.
3) Embargo & announcements: Add optional embargo date tied to product go-live (customer to specify); public announcement requires written approval from Meridian’s comms lead.
4) Confidential info carve-out: Publicity clause must not expose confidential implementation details, pricing, or contract terms.

I’m attaching a redline with concise language that enforces approval steps and a narrow set of permitted channels: Redwood_MSA_redlines_v2.docx. If Meridian prefers broader rights we can loop legal counsel for further negotiation, but this keeps the marketing value while protecting Meridian.

Next steps: Samantha — if you can confirm the comms/legal contact and whether you want an embargo date, I’ll incorporate final language and push the signed order form (RDW_OrderForm_signable.pdf) to DocuSign.

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redlines_v2.docx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben / Laura — appreciate the clear options. Meridian’s position: we’re OK to provide a short quote and logo with the following constraints:

- Embargo: 90 days post go-live before any external announcement.
- Quote approval: Meridian comms will review and approve any wording within 5 business days.
- Channels: Use limited to marketing (case studies, website, sales decks). No paid advertising or partner co-marketing without separate consent.
- Logo: We will share our Brand Guidelines; logo use must follow those specs.

I’ve attached our logo guidelines and marked up one minor point in the MSA redlines (see attachment). Our General Counsel (legal@meridianhealth.com) will do a quick pass; I expect sign-off, but please proceed with your redline incorporation so we can get the order signed.
